integrity: The infinite proof is symbolic and uses the closed-neighborhood and weighted-degree identities; executable finite verification covers constructors through n=80 and first optimizer counts. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proof covers n>=9; small cases n<=8 are outside the new theorem. The odd optimizer description includes a necessary internal Roman-defense clause. This mathematical work does not establish priority against every unindexed work.
title: Exact signed Roman domination and extremal rigidity in two-subset Kneser graphs
